name: system-thinking-skill
description: A portable agent skill that makes an LLM reason about problems and decisions as dynamic systems — stocks and flows, feedback loops, delays, nonlinearity, adaptive actors, and policy resistance — instead of as linear problem-to-solution chains.
author: Younss

scripts.test: node bin/cli.js print > /dev/null && node bin/cli.js install --dir ./.tmp-test --force > /dev/null && test -f ./.tmp-test/systems-thinking/SKILL.md && rm -rf ./.tmp-test && echo ok
